status: Venue model refined with published stage dimensions; independent orientation, canopy-height and quality review pending

source.provider: Purdue University official campus building footprint service
source.reference_status: Mapped venue footprint/envelope; not a certified survey and not assumed to be a wall outline

secondary_visual_references.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
secondary_visual_references.use: Records a 1965 dedication booklet containing facility information; source context only, no plan dimensions extracted.
Confirms Slayter is an outdoor amphitheater; no structural measurements inferred.

Published stage dimensions: 56 ft front, 34 ft rear, 46 ft deep; described as flaring-horn shaped. Used to dimension the stage plan; not treated as an authoritative drawing or survey. Also describes a concrete roof suspended from a steel tripod.

transform.axes: X east, Y north, Z up

measurements.after_venue_envelope_xy_m: Reopened venue geometry, including stage, canopy, supports, steps and seating, lies within the source feature AABB; this AABB check does not verify internal placement or fit to the mapped polygon boundary.
measurements.position_status: Venue feature envelope retained from the official GIS source; stage is placed near the western quarter and audience rows extend east by construction, but no georeferenced plan confirms this internal orientation or placement.
measurements.plan_dimensions_status: Stage plan uses the secondary source dimensions (56 ft front x 34 ft rear x 46 ft deep); seating rows and backstage block are approximate. Official GIS feature is a mapped envelope, not a certified stage footprint.
measurements.orientation_status: Stage faces approximately east in the project-local frame; estimated, with no verified plan or georeferenced photo alignment.
measurements.height_status: Canopy apex is modeled at approximately 9 m; reopened mesh bounds reach 9.157 m because of support geometry. Height is unverified.
measurements.stage_dimension_source_method: Converted the secondary source’s published 56 ft front, 34 ft rear, and 46 ft depth to meters and built a trapezoidal platform. These are source-published dimensions, not independently measured here.

geometry_edits: Replaced the solid extrusion with a trapezoidal stage platform using published 56 ft front width, 34 ft rear width and 46 ft depth dimensions.
Modeled a raised backstage block, front steps, eight approximate audience tiers, three steel tripod supports, a faceted canopy and four suspension cables.
Preserved the building object, collection, scene, asset ID, file path and single-object exported collection.
uncertainties: The official GIS polygon is a mapped venue envelope, not a certified stage or structural-wall perimeter; internal building position and orientation remain unverified.
Stage dimensions are from a secondary written source, not an original or surveyed drawing.
Canopy form, height, cable attachment points, audience tier spacing and backstage block geometry remain estimates.
The natural amphitheater hillside and full audience grounds are not represented as a complete landscape model.
No independent grader has reviewed this revision.
